title: course.json
description: A course: its names, its lecture order, its theme and the platform build its pages are pinned to.

address.description: the published prefix — the URL students read, the edge key and the reader user name; null until an author sets it, and fixed after the first publish

publishedFirst.description: when this course was first published; what makes the address immutable

title.description: the course's name, in its own language

lang.description: the language the course is written in; chosen once when the course is opened. A course stored without one reads as `he`, which is the migration for every course opened before 2026-09-17

dir.description: the reading direction of the course pages. Derived from `lang` (`he` → `rtl`, `en` → `ltr`) and stored so a page and a stylesheet need not compute it; one that disagrees with `lang` is refused

titleEn.description: the Latin-script title, shown in its own bidi isolate; used by a Hebrew course. An English course does not need it and the new-course form does not offer it

theme.description: the course's token set; `PUT /courses/{c}/theme` is what validates it properly

platform.description: the platform hash a published page loads (`/lib/<hash>`), or `dev`

lectures.description: the lecture ids in the lecturer's own order; the importer appends, never reorders
